source.title: Impeachment Trial of Vice President Sara Duterte

turns.speaker: Alfredo Sotto Corpuz
turns.text: Observers are commanded to keep silent under pain

turns.speaker: Alfredo Sotto Corpuz
turns.text: of penalty while the impeachment court is in session for the trial of Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: The impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: is hereby called to order.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: We shall be led in prayer by Senator Judge Bam Aquino.

turns.speaker: Sen. Paolo Benigno “Bam” Aquino
turns.text: Here is a prayer written by Pope St. Leo the Great whose feast day we celebrate today. Let us pray. Hear, O Lord. Hear our prayer, O Lord. And grant us a heart to love you and an earnest desire to please you in all things. Give us, O Lord, the light of your Spirit that we may see the way in which we should walk. Grant that we may not turn aside to the right hand or to the left, but may follow the path of your commandments with an upright heart. May your love be the guide of our actions and your grace our support in every trial, so that we may grow daily in holiness and reach the fullness of eternal life. Amen.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Amen. The clerk of court will now call the roll.

turns.speaker: Atty. Renato N. Bantug Jr.
turns.text: Roll call of members. Senator Judge Aquino. Senator Judge Cayetano Alan. Senator Judge Cayetano Pia. Senator Judge De La Rosa. Senator Judge Ejercito. Senator Judge Estrada. Senator Judge Go. Senator Judge Hontiveros. Senator Judge Lacson. Senator Judge Lapid. Senator Judge Legarda. Senator Judge Marcoleta. Senator Judge Marcos. Senator Judge Padilla, Senator Judge Pangilinan, Senator Judge Sotto III, Senator Judge Tulfo Erwin, Senator Judge Tulfo Raffy, Senator Judge Villanueva, Senator Judge Villar Camille, Senator Judge Villar Mark, Senator Judge Zubiri, The Presiding Officer, Senator Judge Escudero, The Senate President, Senator Judge Gatchalian.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: With 12 Senator Judges present, we declare the presence of a quorum.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: In accordance with the rules of procedure on impeachment trials, the chair now recognizes the duly elected presiding officer to preside over the proceedings of the impeachment court.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Senate President.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: With the permission of the body, before I recognize Senator Judge Sotto, if there are no objections, we shall dispense with the reading of the November 9, 2026 Journal of the Senate sitting as an impeachment court and shall consider the same as approved.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Senator Judge Sotto, what

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: is your pleasure, sir?

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: Good morning. Mr. Presiding Officer. Just as a reminder and perhaps to refresh my memory, is it not we have penalties and sanctions against those who lie before the impeachment court? Will you please refresh my memory on this matter so that the witnesses and the prosecution and the defense will be reminded as well?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: They may be subject to contempt by the court, Mr. Your Honor. And in addition to that, may be subjected to cases of perjury should one be filed against him before the proper prosecutor's office and or courts of law. Because the statements given by any witness is under oath and is therefore covered by our laws on perjury as well. What is the pleasure of Senator Judge Lacson?

turns.speaker: Sen. Panfilo “Ping” M. Lacson
turns.text: Thank you, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Panfilo “Ping” M. Lacson
turns.text: Just to supplement, sir, I was about to make the same manifestation, but since the former Senate President already made the same manifestation, I would just like to supplement by way of mentioning Rule 5 under Resolution 39. This was adopted by the Senate Impeachment Court in March of 2011. And it expressly grants the impeachment court the power to cite for contempt of the court anybody for that matter. And yesterday was not a good day for the impeachment court, Mr. President, Mr. Presiding Officer, simply because we had a witness who smirked, who laughed, almost made a mockery of the impeachment trial. And we don't want to have a repeat of that kind of testimony. So, just a reminder to everyone that this is not an implied power of the impeachment court, Mr. Presiding Officer, but an express power granted by such resolution. Thank you.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Duly noted and well taken. Thank you, Senator Judge Lacson. What is the pleasure of the Senate President?

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Just to correct the number of senators earlier, we have 13 senator judges present.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Before calling on the next witness, Chair would like to state something also in relation to

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Engineer Jimmy yesterday.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Yesterday, a request was made by Senator Judge Aquino as well as Senator Judge Hontiveros for the list of properties.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: owned and or in the name of singularly or jointly of Attorney Carpio and the Vice President. For the record, for the information of the Senator Judges, we have not received such a report from Engineer Adalin. Neither have we received a copy or name of the travel agency requested by Senator Judge Rafi Tulfo. The Chair therefore directs the Clerk of Court to kindly communicate with Engineer Adalin and follow up on the same. If by tomorrow the same is not yet complied with, unless sufficient cause or reason is given, the Court will be forced to issue compulsory process on the same. Yes, what is the pleasure of Senator Judge Risa?

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Salamat tabi, Mr. Presiding Officer. Unless the Presiding Officer will indeed give Engineer Adalin until tomorrow to submit the court's requested documents, may I just remind all of us that I actually requested him and he committed to furnishing us those documents within yesterday, Mr. Presiding Officer. Salamat.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Again, chair reiterates his directive to the clerk of court to kindly communicate with him and to kindly explain, to kindly comply and or explain why he has not yet been able to comply and if at all when he can comply.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Appearances of the parties, apologies, counsels.

turns.speaker: Rep. Terry L. Ridon
turns.text: Good morning, your honors. Same

turns.speaker: Rep. Terry L. Ridon
turns.text: appearances for the prosecution.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: And I presume, honorable Ridon, that attorney Tolosa will again stand for the prosecution.

turns.speaker: Rep. Terry L. Ridon
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: I see him nodding. Attorney Sheila, good morning. Appearances?

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: Good morning, Your Honor. Same appearance for the respondent accused. Before we proceed to the examination of our next witness, Your Honor, I will just inform the court and or request the court to allow the defense to manifest some matters in relation to an order given by this court. And this can be done at the conclusion or before the conclusion of the hearing today, before the adjournment. Thank you, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: We shall allow that. Who will be handling the direct examination of Engineer Enumerables?

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: It will be Attorney Lindon, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Attorney Lindon. Okay.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Kindly call Engineer John Kenneth Enumerables to the witness stand. Situate him rather to the witness stand.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Good morning, your honor. Good

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: morning, attorney Lindon.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: May we call engineer John Kenneth Enumerables to the witness stand.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Good morning as well to you, attorney Tolosa.

turns.speaker: Atty. Benjamin Tolosa Jr.
turns.text: Good morning, your honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Benjamin Tolosa Jr.
turns.text: Same appearance.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: The clerk of court is directed to administer the oath to the witness.

turns.speaker: Atty. Renato N. Bantug Jr.
turns.text: Sir, can I

turns.speaker: Atty. Renato N. Bantug Jr.
turns.text: rise and please raise your right hand? You, John Kenneth Enumerables, do swear that the evidence you shall give in the case now pending. Between the Philippines and Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte shall be the truth, the whole truth, and nothing but the truth. So help you God.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Kindly answer using the mic, Engineer.

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you. Ano po ang palayaw niyo, Engineer?

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: Kenneth, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Kenneth, mas maikli yun dyan, yung pinili mo yung mas mahaba talaga.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Engineer Kenneth, naunawaan niyo po ba yung inyong pinanumpaan kaugnay sa testimonyong bibigay niyo sa harap ng hukumang ito?

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: Opo, Yanar.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Engineer, napakinggan niyo po kanina ang mga pahayag ng ilang senator judges kaugnay sa naging pagpapakita nung naunang testigo kahapon. Sana po ay maiwasan niyo po yun sa inyong pagtitestigo sa araw na ito.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Attorney Lindon, offer?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: May we request the tech to show the offer of testimony.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Tech is so directed. Also in relation to this witness, the chair gives continuing authority to both parties to assign assisting counsel to approach the witness at any point in time or for examining counsels to approach the witness at any time. You may proceed, Attorney Lindon.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor. Thank you, Your Honor. The testimony of Engineer John Kenneth Enumerables is offered to prove That he is the City Assessor of Island Garden, City of Samal, his duties and responsibilities, and that he has personal knowledge on tax declarations. To prove that the real property, covered by Transfer Certificate of Title No. 142-2019-013134, is disclosed by the Vice President in her Statement of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth, To prove that the prosecution's accusation that the respondent did not disclose the real property covered by transfer certificate of title number 142-2019-013134 in her SALNs is malicious and completely false.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: To

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: identify and authenticate tax declarations and other related documents concerning transfer certificate of title number 142-2019-013134 and to prove other relevant matters.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: This is almost the same offer as yesterday, correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Benjamin Tolosa Jr.
turns.text: Comment, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Almost the same comment, I guess, Atty. Tolosa?

turns.speaker: Atty. Benjamin Tolosa Jr.
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. But if you could just specify that we are willing to stipulate again with respect to purpose number one regarding his... position as the City Assessor of City Garden of Samal. And again, similar to yesterday, we take strong exception to the allegations that the position of the respondent or of the prosecution was falsely and maliciously done. That the property reflected in that TSN was not reflected in the SALN. Considering that same As the property discussed yesterday in Matina, Davao, in this property also, there are glaring discrepancies between that property contained in the TSN and the property contained in the TSN, which would show that they're completely different properties and there's no way that this witness could prove that they're the same properties. All that he could testify to is again, at most, they're in the same barangay.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Your Honor, can we just move to strike the manifestation of the counsel for the prosecution? It appears that he is testifying, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Benjamin Tolosa Jr.
turns.text: Definitely not. And the terms malicious and falsely made came from the defense. So they cannot expect us to take that sitting down and not vehemently object to it.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: It is part of our offer of testimony.

turns.speaker: Atty. Benjamin Tolosa Jr.
turns.text: Which is improper. That's why I'm responding to it accordingly.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: It is not improper because we want this honorable court to appreciate the testimony of this witness in that light, Your Honor. And we're stating the fact.

turns.speaker: Atty. Benjamin Tolosa Jr.
turns.text: We will just leave the matter to the judicious discretion.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Same ruling as

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: yesterday. Let it remain in the record and subject to a cross.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: However, Attorney Lindon, I presume, again, for the understanding of the senator judges and the public as well, may aligasyon yung prosecution noon na itong lupang ito covered by TCT ending in 3134 ay hindi dineklara sa SALN na yung kalawang pangulo. Nais mong patunayan sa pamamagitan ng testigong ito na ito'y dineklara sa kanyang SALN. Would that be correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: That is correct,

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: And given the stipulation as to the first offer and the qualification of the witness, you may proceed directly to the point you want to establish so that we can understand it more clearly.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: And kindly help us out to remove it from the realm of possibilities to the actual realm of actuality na ito yung ito ngayon. Kindly help us see that counsel through this witness. If indeed that is what this witness will be testifying on.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Understood, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: You

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: may proceed, Sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor. Good morning, Sir.

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: Good

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: morning, Sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Please state your name for the record, Sir.

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: I am Engineer John Kenneth Daguhoy Enumerables.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: What is your profession, Sir?

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: I am a licensed civil engineer. And

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: also,

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: I am a registered, a licensed real estate appraiser.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: How long have you been a engineer, sir?

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: I passed the board exam in the year 2000.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: And how long have you been a real estate appraiser, sir?

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: I passed the board exam for the real estate appraiser in the year 2011.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: What are your duties and responsibilities as the City Assessor of the Island Garden City of Samal?

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: The City Assessor is responsible for the classification, assessment, appraisal, valuation of all real property within the territorial jurisdiction of the City for taxation purposes.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: In relation to the To your duties and responsibilities, what records are maintained by the city assessor in his office, sir?

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: First is the tax declarations, the tax maps, the tax mapping control roll or TMCR, the field appraisal and assessment sheet or FAAS, and other assessment records, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Yesterday, the Engineer Adalin already testified about tax maps. But in relation to the City Assessor's Office of Island Garden City of Samal, you mentioned tax maps. What are tax maps?

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: Tax maps is a document used to identify and locate all real property. within the territorial jurisdiction of the city for the real property taxation.

turns.speaker: Atty. Benjamin Tolosa Jr.
turns.text: Your Honor, excuse me. I'm sorry. Just to move things along, we're willing to stipulate that the same descriptions given by the witness yesterday regarding the same documents that both of them will be testifying on. We're willing to stipulate on that so that we don't have to go through this tedious exercise.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: The authenticity as well as the due execution of the documents he will present?

turns.speaker: Atty. Benjamin Tolosa Jr.
turns.text: We'll also be willing to stipulate upon seeing them, because we have not yet seen them. We'll just examine them closely.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Haven't you been given a copy?

turns.speaker: Atty. Benjamin Tolosa Jr.
turns.text: Not yet, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Have we given a copy?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Kindly give a copy of the documents submitted to the clerk.

turns.speaker: Atty. Benjamin Tolosa Jr.
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor. And I think right now, the defense has the point of explaining what are these documents, what are their purposes. We're just

turns.speaker: Atty. Benjamin Tolosa Jr.
turns.text: stipulating, Your Honor,

turns.speaker: Atty. Benjamin Tolosa Jr.
turns.text: to move things along that the description given yesterday, we're willing to adopt. The

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: stipulation is duly noted. Kindly take note as well, Attorney Lindon, so that you don't have to go through the longer route of proving the authenticity of the documents.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: You

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: may proceed, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Your Honor, may we just clarify if we will dispense with questions regarding the nature of tax maps, tax declarations, their manner of creation, and the proper custodian of these documents.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: I presume

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: that's what the intention of Atty. Tolosa is. He admits and stipulates to that already in relation to this witness.

turns.speaker: Atty. Benjamin Tolosa Jr.
turns.text: Confirmed, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. But we would have to still lay the basis for the nature of these documents, Your Honor. Because even though these are the same kind of documents as that which was identified and authenticated by... City Assessor Office of

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Davao City.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: I understand what you're saying, counsel. Yes, you can explain because each city, each local government unit has its own way of coming up with its tax map and or system of zoning. So you can proceed to lay the basis in that regard. However, in regard to the documents you will present, you can dispense with the authenticity and execution of the same, including identification of the same.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Thank

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: you, Your Honor. You may

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: proceed, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: You earlier mentioned about tax map, sir. How are tax maps created, sir?

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: It's created to, first, the gathering of the data, just like the cadastral maps, the approved subdivision plan, and even the title. Then second, we conducted surveys and ocular inspections and verifications.

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: Then third is the identifications of the lot number and plotting of the parcels on the map.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: You mentioned about data, sir. Where do you get the data you required for...

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: Data is coming...

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: Sorry, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Let me finish, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Sorry. Where do you get the data in relation to the creation of a tax map, sir?

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: The data is coming from the DENR, the cadastral maps, and also the approved subdivision plan is from the DENR.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: And, sino naman po yung gumagawa ng tax maps sa City Assessor's Office ng Island Garden City of Samal, Sir?

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: The preparation of the tax map is in our tax mapping division.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Tax mapping division.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Yung purpose ng tax map, Sir? Ano po yung purpose niya, Sir?

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: Ang purpose po yung tax map is to Identify and locate the properties within the city.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: And how do you ensure, sir, that the tax mapping records of the city assessor's office of Island Garden City of Samal are accurate, sir?

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: Because we base on the approved subdivision plan and the technical description in the title.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: You also mentioned, sir, about that the city assessor's office Also keeps tax declarations. Ano po ba yung tax declarations in relation sa opisina ng Samal assessor's office, sir?

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: The tax declaration, it is a document used to identify and determine the taxable assessed value of the property for taxation purposes.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Ano po bang taxes ang may kinalaman sa tax declaration?

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: Yung real property tax, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Sa... Sa Samal sir, sino ba yung mga kailangan magbayad ng real property tax?

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: The property owner or his or her representative.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: And sa Samal po, paano po binabayaran sa inyo yung real property tax?

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: First, they will secure a tax declaration from our office. Then after that... They proceed to the office of the city treasurer for the payment of the real property tax.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Thank you, sir. Sir, in relation to this case, do you confirm having received a subpena duces tecum and a testificandum, sir?

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: And what documents did you bring in compliance with the subpena issued by this court, sir?

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: I required to bring the certified true copy of the tax declaration. Tax Map, Tax Mapping Control Roll or the TMCR, Field Appraisal and Assessment Sheet or the FAAS, Certificate of Title, Tax Clearance, e-car from the BIR, and other documents.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: For the record, Your Honor, we confirm receipt from this honorable court. Documents produced by the witness, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Sir,

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: tama dito sa mga documents na binala mo may tax clearance.

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Ano po ba itong tax clearance na ito, sir?

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: Tax clearance, it is a certification issued by the City Treasurer's Office and that document is one of the requirements. In the transfer of ownership in the tax declaration.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Ano po ba yung pinapakita ng tax clearance na ito, sir?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Na

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: dinala nyo?

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: Makita po doon kung fully paid na po yung isang property po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: May hawak po ba kayong kopya ng tax clearance ngayon, sir?

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: Yes, sir. I have it in my document, sir.

turns.text: Okay. Thank you, Mr. Presiding Officer. Sa atin mong testigo, Engineer, bago po kayo tumistigo dito, tinignan niyo po ba para makita kung may mga discrepancy ito po mga papeles? Alam niyo naman po kung anong ititistigo po ninyo. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: Nagkumpara po, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Hindi po ninyo nakita yung problema na ito, na yung samatanos na ito na sinasabi nyo hindi nyo alam kung merong barangay na gano'n? Hindi po ninyo tinignan?

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: Hindi na po, Your Honor, kasi yung property is located at sa residro, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Kaya nga po, pero sinasabi nyo, hindi po kayo nagtaka na matanos, parang walang ganon. Hindi ninyo nakita or nakita nyo po na may discrepancy na, may pinagkaiba sa doon po sa titulo at saka versus doon po sa hawak niyo papel.

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: Base po sa technical description po ng titulo po, doon po siya naka-situated po sa Barangay Sinisidro po, yung survey number po niya.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Opo, pero hindi nyo tinignan. Kasi sa TCT po nakalagay po matanos. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: Yes po. Tinignan ko po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: O hindi ko kayo nagtaka. Ba't magkaiba ito?

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: Yan nga po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Alright. And then my next question. First time ba ninyong nakainkwentro ng ganitong problema o discrepancy pag minamatch po ninyo yung records po ninyo pati ng RD? First time po ba ninyo ito?

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: Sa Island Garden City, Samal po. Marami pong ganon po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Maraming ganon na magkaiba.

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: Magkaiba yung barangay. Yung old barangay po yung nasulat po sa titulo. Pero ito po parang non-existent po yata.

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: Kasi po yung tax mapping po is 1996 po yung nag-tax mapping. So yung mga barangay po doon po na-rehistro.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Okay, moving forward. If may mga problema po na ganito, don't you ever wonder and call the attention of the Register of Deeds or LRA? Partner, may problema. Itong may-ari ng titulo, iba yung sinasabi dito, iba yung sa amin. Hindi kayo naguusap-usap?

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: Hindi na po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Bakit po?

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: Kasi po, hindi na po namin saklaw yung trabaho nila po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Hindi yun yung saklaw, pero responsibilidad, hunin nyo. Bapano na lang kung peke palang titulo ang hawak ng pobring tao, bumili siya ng lupa, iba yung pangalan sa inyo, iba yung pangalan sa kabila. Papano? Yan ang problema sa atin. Dapat, kayo ho'y nasa assessor, it's your responsibility. Kahit papano, sabihan nyo man lang po ang RD. Sir, baka peke ho itong hawak ng pobring tao na ito nakabili ng lupa. Malay natin, baka peke yung titulo. I mean, make sure po yung due diligence, sir. Ano po? As a government official, part po nating trabaho is public service. O po?

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: Yes,

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: your honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Maraming salamat po, presiding officer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you, Senator Judge Erwin. Senator Judge Risa is recognized. You have two minutes, ma'am. Senator Judge, Senate President Gatchalian is recognized. You may proceed, sir. You have two minutes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Presiding Officer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Katulad po ng presiding officer po natin, naguguluhan rin po ako, engineer. Dahil nga doon sa tax dexan, Isidro, sa titulo, Barangay Matanos, At sa SALN, Barangay Matanos. Dahil siguro nasa titulo, Barangay Matanos. Nakita ko rin po dito na ito ay parte ng isang resort development ng Filinvest. Tama po ba? Itong pinag-uusapan natin ng property?

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: Yes

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Kasama ito doon sa, parang nakita ko development ng Filinvest.

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: Yes po, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: So marami rin pong kumuha ng tax deck doon? Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: Yes, Yon.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Yung Filinvest Development, itong Kembali Coast, ang titulo ba nito ay Barangay Matanos?

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: Lahat po ng titulo po ay Barangay Matanos na nakalagay sa title po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: So itong buong Kembali Coast, Barangay Matanos ang titulo niya?

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: Yes, Yon.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Pero

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: rinirehistro ninyo, Barangay Isidro?

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: Yes po, based po sa tax mapping namin, Yon.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Dahil walang, officially walang Barangay Matanos?

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: Yes, correct, Yon.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Ito bang lugar na ito? Dati po bang may mother title to na malaki na barangay Matanos? Anong history ho nitong barangay Isidro? Saan Isidro?

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: May mother title yan yun.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Ano yung mother title ho nito?

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: Yun lang po yun. Hindi ko po dala yun.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Ano ba siya? Dati bang barangay? Kasi nangyayari rin po nagpapalit ng pangalan ng barangay. Ito ba

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: ba ay dati bang barangay Matanos?

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: I have

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: no idea, Your Honor. Hindi ko po nakita.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: With the permission of the Senate President, the mother title of Filinvest at least, kasi doon binili yun eh,

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: indicates

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: also the location as Barangay Matanos.

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Presiding Officer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Yung pupunta naman po ako doon sa presyo, dahil magkaiba ho yung presyo. SALN 4 Million, Deed of Sale 3.4 Million. Sa inyong being an assessor at appraiser, bakit ho tingin niyo magkaiba ang presyo?

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: Sa

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: acquisition cost o sa purchase price?

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Opo, yung purchase price is 3.4 Million at sa SALN is 4 Million. Anong tingin niyo ho base sa inyong karanasan?

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: Acquisition cost po is ito na po yung kabuwang gasto po ng isang property na nabili po ng isang owner po. Yung purchase price po is yung presyo ng isang property po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Anong ibig sabihin ng kabuwang gastos?

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: Kasali na po yung mga expenses po ng pagpa-transfer ng title. Yun po ang pagka-indidiko po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: So kasama na po dito let's say yung capital gains.

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: Yes, yun

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: ang pagkaintindi ko. Transfer fees. Ano po yung mga posibleng cost? Gayo, bilang an appraiser.

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: The capital gain tax, documentary tax, the transfer, the transfer, owner's certificate of transfer, then dun po sa registry of deeds po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: So kung idadagdag natin to, pwede ba siyang umabot ng ganitong 4 million? More or less lang. More or less.

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: Possibly po, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Possibly siyang umabot ho doon.

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Dito ba sa, dito sa Kembali Coast, sa inyong experience ba ho? Pag sinama po itong mga added costs, mga taxes, transfer costs, ito ha, sa Kembali Coast, pwede bang umabot ho ng, kasi yung difference kanina narinig ko sa prosecution, 500,000, pwede umabot ba ho ng 500,000 additional costs?

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Dito sa Kembali Coast?

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Maraming salamat, Engineer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you. Senator Judge Villanueva, you may proceed, sir. You have two minutes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Presiding Officer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Ganda nga po, no? Akta ng dahali. Sir, una, nung tinatanong po kayo about Barangay Matanos, sabi niyo walang Barangay Matanos, pero ngayon sinasabi niyo halos lahat ng titulo nakalagay Matanos.

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: Doon po sa titulo yun.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Pero bakit po kanina ang tagal niyong malaman na may barangay matanos? Kasi nalito po kami. So yung San Isidro, barangay San Isidro, wala po yan sa mga titulo?

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: Sa titulo po ng Kimbali po, hindi po nakalagay yung San Isidro. Lahat po matanos po nakalagay.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Ngayon, doon po sa dalawang, masasabi po ba agad natin na iisang lupa talaga? Yung binabanggit dito sa usapin natin dito sa Korte dahil lang doon sa description na binabanggit nyo o meron po bang ibang detalya pa na kailangan po nating paghambingin para masiguro talaga natin na itong dalawang dokumento ay tumutukoy sa isang parcel of land. Yung pong itong TCT No. 142-2019-013134.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Uulitin ko yung tanong ko po. Meron po ba tayong iba pang detalye na kailangang makita, malaman, para masiguro natin, mapaghambing natin, na matiyak natin na ito pong dalawang dokumento ay tumutukoy sa iisang parcel of land?

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: Sa opisina po ng City Assurance Office po, mayroon kaming dokumento yung total landholding po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: I'm sorry,

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: sorry, total?

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: Total landholding po. So makita po doon kung ilang property po ang naka-declare ng isang tao po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: O kasi nga po ito po, yung March 15, 2018, deed of absolute sale, in-identify po yung pag-purchase nitong property. Pero doon sa reported 2019, SALN, nakalagay acquisition year of 2013. Pag tinignan niyo po ito, may limang taong gap. Limang taon yung acquisition gap. Kung talaga pong nakuha na yung property noong 2013, meron ho ba kayo sa inyong opisina na magpapatunay na dokumento na ito ay nakuha noong 2013 at the same po yung property na yon dito sa 2018 deed of absolute sale?

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: Will we reply po sa opisina po kung meron po?

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: O hindi niyo po sigurado?

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: Ah, kasi po wala akong dalawang dokumento. We will verify.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: So

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: kung iaharap po sa inyo yung tax declaration at ang SALN entry na nagsasabi po na may residential property dito sa Matanos o Kaputian District, maaari po ba ninyong matukoy kung ang dalawang dokumento ay tumutukoy sa iisang lupa? Sa inyong professional na karanasan, experience o kaalaman at batay po doon sa official records ng inyong tanggapan, ano po yung masasabi nyo tungkol doon sa pagkakatugma ng property na binabanggit po natin? Exactly the same po ba?

turns.speaker: Engr. John Kenneth D. Enumerables
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. Isa lang po yun.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Salamat po, Mr. Witness. Thank you.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you, Senator Judge Villanueva. Chair confirms. The statement earlier made by Attorney Linden pertaining to the testimony of Mr. Marco Pineda, the Acting Register of Deeds of IGACOS, on October 1, specifically for the information of Senator Judges, pages 95 to 97, upon the inquiry made by the presiding officer, where Mr. Pineda confirmed that Nanggaling daw kasi sa mother title yung mga nakalagay sa titulo at nakalagay sa mother title Matanos pa rin at under PD 1529. Hindi po daw nila pwedeng baguhin yun at kine-carry over lang nila gamit niyang salita mula sa ina papunta sa anak nung titulo at kaya na-carry over po yung titulong yun at para malaman daw para sigurado na yun yung parehong lupa. Ay kailangan tingnan sa tax mapping sa City Assessor's Office para matingnan at makita kung yun nga po ay pareho o magkaibang piraso ng lupa yun. Chair would like to make some interjections. Atty. Tolosa, you made mention of the fact na unang dineklara yung lupa, 2013?

turns.speaker: Atty. Benjamin Tolosa Jr.
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. And actually not 2013 because I think the Vice President was not in public office at that time. So I think it was declared first in 2015.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Sorry, it was

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: declared in 2015 but made mention of the sale

turns.speaker: Atty. Benjamin Tolosa Jr.
turns.text: Yes, yes, your honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: And they placed installment.

turns.speaker: Atty. Benjamin Tolosa Jr.
turns.text: Yes, that is the mode of payment, installment.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Under

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: the deed of sale, ilan taon po yung installment?

turns.speaker: Atty. Benjamin Tolosa Jr.
turns.text: I think the schedule of payments was not indicated in the deed

turns.speaker: Atty. Benjamin Tolosa Jr.
turns.text: of sale.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So natanggal yung installment. Diba? At the particular year, if I recall correctly, after five years in 2018, na wala na yung installment, nilagay na niya na sale.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So I presume na natapos na installment on the fifth year.

turns.speaker: Atty. Benjamin Tolosa Jr.
turns.text: But you're on that point. That's why we asked the witness to confirm a while ago that there is no contract to sell annotated in the transfer certificate of titles or mentioned in the deed of absolute sale.

turns.speaker: Atty. Benjamin Tolosa Jr.
turns.text: If the only document that we have here is the deed of absolute sale which was executed in 2018.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Well, the deed of absolute sale, counsel, if at all, the deed of absolute sale would be the final document that you execute in order to transfer the property. Ngayon, kung bahagi pa siya ng mother title, hindi ka naman mag-i-issue ng title, diba? I don't know if you've tried buying from a subdivision. Hindi ka naman mag-i-issue ng title. Carve it out from the mother title in an installment sale and then annotate at the back that it's for installment. You will issue the title simply after it has been fully paid. That's the common practice.

turns.speaker: Atty. Benjamin Tolosa Jr.
turns.text: But our point is, Your Honor, there is nowhere in the documents which would indicate that the property covered by this TCT was agreed to be paid in an installment basis or that a contract to sell was executed before a deed of absolute sale was executed 2018. And of course, your Honor, it is common sometimes a contract to sell is first executed if there are installment basis and then after all of the payments have been made, then they execute the deed of absolute sale. But that is not an absolute requirement. It is also completely possible that you go directly to a DOAS.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Now, my next question, Attorney Tolosa, is forgive me if I'm asking you these questions because it goes to the heart of the theory of the prosecution.

turns.speaker: Atty. Benjamin Tolosa Jr.
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: In both these parcels of land that you claim the Vice President did not declare, the one in Davao City and the one in... and IGACOS. You took issue at the fact na magkaiba yung acquisition cost.

turns.speaker: Atty. Benjamin Tolosa Jr.
turns.text: That's

turns.speaker: Atty. Benjamin Tolosa Jr.
turns.text: correct.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Siyempre, sasabihin ni Atty. Lindon, ang nilagay acquisition cost sa SALN, iba naman yung binayaran talaga, which will include transfer taxes, capital gains tax, doc stamps, whatever. Or, yung totoong presyo.

turns.speaker: Atty. Benjamin Tolosa Jr.
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Kasi di ba usually in deed of sale, binababahan yan? It's common practice. As long as it is in excess of the Assessed value, you usually put it below the market value, hindi naman illegal yun, para mas mababa, hindi ba? Yung capital gains tax, transfer taxes, doc stamps, at iba pa. So, is it your contention na if the Vice President declared this, she would have over-declared? Na ang value ng lupa based on the deed of sale is only 3 million but she declared 4 million? Na ang value ng lupa dun sa Davao City is how much? 4 million? Dineclare niya 10 million. Aside from the inconsistency, is it possible she over-declared?

turns.speaker: Atty. Benjamin Tolosa Jr.
turns.text: First of all, thank you for the question and the opportunity to explain this.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Yes, please.

turns.speaker: Atty. Benjamin Tolosa Jr.
turns.text: With respect to the acquisition cost, Memorandum Circular No. 2, Series of 2013, issued by the Civil Service Commission with the subject revised statement of assets, liabilities, and net worth form. Page 4. Acquisition cost is the amount of money paid to acquire or own something. Now, if we correlate this with the Civil Code, Your Honor, in order for a transfer of ownership, in order for a sale to be consummated, in order for a person to own something, all you need to do is to fulfill the requirements for a valid contract. You just need to

turns.speaker: Atty. Benjamin Tolosa Jr.
turns.text: have a meeting of the minds, an object certain, and the consideration. All of these taxes In fees, they are not required to own something, to acquire something. You just need them possibly so that you'll be able to transfer the property under your name. In fact, under the same rules, you are required to declare in the SALN a real property that you bought. With a deed of absolute sale, even if that property has not yet been transferred under your name. So it is clear, if you will reconcile all of these provisions together, for the acquisition cost, you don't have to and you shouldn't include the taxes and the fees because you did not pay them to acquire it.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: But if I want to be safe, isn't it better to over-declare? What I paid instead of under-declaring it because I will be placed in this situation. Na yung dineklara ko, mababa dun sa aktual. Hindi ba para maging safe ka, iaakyat mo? Meaning, now my question is, is that a crime? Because right now, the crime is not to declare.

turns.speaker: Atty. Benjamin Tolosa Jr.
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Now, is it your position that it's also a crime if at all to over... Declare? Meaning, tama ka. Basis sa guidelines, hindi mo kailangan na deklara. Eh gusto ko eh, para klaro. Ito naman talaga yung binayad ko eh. Ngayon, minaji ko ng konti yung deed of sale eh, para mas mababay. Di ba, as a lawyer, you know that. Lawyers and accountants do that. Advise that to

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: their clients.

turns.speaker: Atty. Benjamin Tolosa Jr.
turns.text: I don't, Your Honor, for the record.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Within the

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: bounds of law, of course, because it's not technically illegal. As long as, di ba, pasok ka. Now, gusto niya i-declare yung totoong binayad. Now, is that a violation of the SALN law? Is there a provision that says it's a violation? Admittedly, you don't have to.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: But

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: if you do, did you violate anything?

turns.speaker: Atty. Benjamin Tolosa Jr.
turns.text: First and foremost, Your Honor, our position is these are not the same properties.

turns.speaker: Atty. Benjamin Tolosa Jr.
turns.text: And

turns.speaker: Atty. Benjamin Tolosa Jr.
turns.text: the proposition that she just over-declared it, first of all,

turns.speaker: Atty. Benjamin Tolosa Jr.
turns.text: We will not take that position because there are clear guidelines that must be followed in filling up your SALN form. And as I've explained, based on these guidelines, you don't need to put those figures because they're not part of the acquisition cost. Now, if they will take the position that she did, Your Honor, that is speculation. The only person who could say that is the Vice President and she will have to take the stand and make that explanation, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: I'm going there. Attorney Lindon, is that the...

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: If you are claiming that this is the same property,

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: given

turns.text: Kasi kanina sa defense, Mr. Presiding Officer, tatakalaan ko puro signature ang pinag-uusapan. Marami siya mga katanungan tungkol sa mga signatures and yet hindi niya tinalakay yung sulat kamay doon, I think January 2021 and December 2021, tapos may pirma.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: You're

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: referring to the disbursement voucher.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Disbursement voucher. So, bakit? Sulat kamay ang nilagay doon para sa disbursement voucher. Sana tinanong ninyo, bakit sulat kamay ang nilagay doon? Bakit? At saka binura, Mr. President, ah, yeah, Mr. President Officer, may binura na date eh, na 2022. Rinas out, and then naglagay ng pirma, and then sa baba, naglagay ng dalawang dates. Na pwede namang isulat yun later on, nung magkaroon ng impeachment, nung malalaman na magkaroon ng impeachment. So sana tinanong lang, I was just waiting for you to ask that question. Bakit krinash yung original na naka-type na date na entry, ginawa ng pirma, and then nagkaroon ng bagong entry, which is a different date, at nagkaroon ng pirma. I was just waiting for you to ask those questions na bakit naka ganito. Normal ba ganito? Kasi, Mr. Presiding Officer, alam naman natin lahat na once you become the Vice President, hindi ka na dapat pwede tumanggap ng double compensation. So, if this was for the purpose of dahil... From the previous years before she became VP, ba't di lang natin hintayin na after na maging VP siya, sakala ibigay yung pera niya? Di ba? Kaysa naman bibigay natin habang siya ay VP na alam naman natin bawal. Yun lang mo, Mr. President, I was just waiting for him to ask those questions.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Allow the chair, Senator Judge Raffi. Doon po sa disbursement voucher, Ma'am Evan.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Kinansila yung January 1 to 31, 2022. Pero may countersign naman ni Janice. Tapos sinulat po ni Janice, January to December 2020, countersign uli. January to December 2021, countersign uli. Bakit po niya ginawa yun?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Kasi po ang mga supporting documents po. Makikita naman na for 2020 and 2021 po. Para madali makita po ni Kowa yung sa voucher, meron na pong January-December 2020 and January-December 2021 po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: mali po yung December 1 to 31, 2022.

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Yes po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Kinorek po niya.

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Kinorek po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: At kinuntersign po niya.

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Yes po, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: When was it corrected?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Sa pag-evaluate pa po, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: No, when was it corrected? Just answer me straight.

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Ang noong date po na na-process ng City Accountant's Office po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: On that date. So December 30, 2022.

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Yes po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Tama. Doon po niya kinurik yan?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Yes po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: So noong 2022 niya kinurik?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Yes po. Kasi na-process na...

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Kasi alam niya na bawal. Kaya niya kinurik.

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Wala. Kasi

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: alam niya na bawal na hindi pwedeng tumanggap na double compensation ang BP. Kaya ginawa niya, kinurik niya, ginawa niya 2021.

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Ang preparation po ng voucher is matagal na po. Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Kaya nga, pero yung pagbabago, it was done after the fact.

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Hindi

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: po, during po sa preparation ng voucher.

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: 2022. Upon checking po kasi sa City Accountant's Office kami naman po ang mag-evaluate ng vouchers.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Kaya nga po dito 2022 nga po na-release yung voucher diba? 2022 BP na si BP Sara. Tama?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Dated po ito December 30 na 2022.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: So she's already the Vice President at that time. Tama.

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Processing po. Ang pag-process nila po sa city mayors kasi po sila ang nag-process. Tapos dumating po sa amin for payable kasi ito December 30, 2022 po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: O sana hindi niyo muna in-relation ang point ko. So hinintayin niyo na lang kasi alam niyo naman BP na siya. Hindi siya pwedeng tumanggap ng pangalawang sweldo or another sweldo outside of being BP. Hinintayin niyo na lang after na maging BP siya sa 2028. So wala na problema. So parang lumilito ito ha.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Para lumilitaw na gumawa kayo ng alteration, gumawa kayo ng pagbabago dahil alam nyo bawal kaya kinoss out nyo yung original entry tapos sa ilalim nun naglagay ka ng dalawang entry and then naglagay lang kayo ng countersign. I was just waiting for him to ask those questions which he did not. Kaya nga ako tumayo rito ngayon.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Presiding Officer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: I think the direct examination is not yet finished, Senator Judge Raffy. We don't know yet how Attorney Lindon will wind up. Number two,

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: The payment was made, for the record, in 2023. The reimbursement voucher was prepared in 2022 for a supposed salary differential given the salary increase of the position of mayor in 2020 and 2021. Is that correct, Atty. Lindon?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. And just to clarify, Your Honor, just to... For the record, the defense is not yet done with the direct examination. We just completed with the identification and marking of the documents, Your Honor. And we were about to ask the same questions, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: We'll allow it. The comments of Senator Judge Raffi are duly noted. Attorney Lindon, you may proceed.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Thank

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: you, Your Honor. Yung nabanggit niyo pong amount na 64,194 pesos and 72 centavos, kailan po ito na-release?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: January ito po sa cheque po, na-issue po ang cheque nito is January 10, 2023 po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Bakit po nung 2023 lang ito na-release?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Na-complete po ang supporting documents on that year po, 2023. Kasi hindi naman kami makarelease kung hindi po complete po yung mga supporting documents.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Bakit po noong 2023 nyo lang na-complete po yung mga supporting documents?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Na-comply na po lahat ng supporting documents in the year 2023 po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Ano po bang mga supporting documents yung i-comply nyo dapat?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Marami po siya. Isa po nito, itong mga ito po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Ano po? Sige po. Pakisabi po.

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: NOSA po. Itong naka-attach po dito. Yung mga payroll register at NOSA po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Yung 64,194 pesos and 72 centavos, ma'am. Saan galing ito?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Sa salary differentials po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Ano na nga po yung salary differential, ma'am? Salary

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Differentials,

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Ma'am.

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: May salary standardization law po tayo noong 2019 na may yearly tranches po na increase.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Anong public official, anong position po na public official ang may kinalaman sa salary increase? Anong...

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Yung

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: salary standardization law of 2019 po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Ano pong official yung mga covered dun sa increase na yun?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Lahat po ng empleyado ng government po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Kasama po ba dun ng mayor?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: We'll

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: allow

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: it for brevity, counsel.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: In relation po dito sa salary differential na sinabi nyo, may sinabit pa rin po ba kayo sa BIR? Kung meron man?

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Leading your honor, I've been very lenient your honor, but it appears that every time the good counsel could not elicit the proper answer by asking the proper question, he would resort to asking leading questions.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Well, I checked the TSN too, Atty. Mae, and the basis of why they need to Call this witness and explain the amount received by the respondent is because of the testimony of the BIR. In fact, I was hoping he would be dealing with that issue earlier but I'll allow it at this point so that we can address the issue squarely in regard to the allegation raised by the prosecution. Again, for the information of the senator judges.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: During the presentation of the BIR witness, a form was presented showing that the Vice President received an amount of money from the city of Davao, corresponding to the amount being discussed now.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So, yes, we will in the meantime overrule it, Atty. May, and allow the witness to answer. Kindly respond, ma'am, did you submit any document to the BIR in regard to this payment made to the Vice President?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Yes po. As attachment po sa compensation paid ng city government po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Is this required by law for you to submit?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Yes po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Ngayon itong salary differential, sweldo ba ito? Compensation ba ito kay VP Sara para sa anong period?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: 2020 and 21 year honor po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Para

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: sa anong pwesto?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: As city mayor po siya.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Dahil tumaas yung sweldo niya sa ngayon sa salary standardization law ng 2019, noong 2020 at 2021 habang City Mayor siya.

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Yes po, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Paano naman yung City Mayor siya mula 2020, January 2022 hanggang June 29, 2022?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Bayad po, Your Honor. Nakaprepare po ang City Mayor's Office ng salary adjustment po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: But wala dito.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Meron din ba kayong ginawang ganun?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: May monthly kasi during January pag payroll po. Tama na po yung na-prepare nila noong January 2022 po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Hindi po. Ang tanong ko po, yung mga dokumentong nandito is para sa salary differential ni Vice President bilang Mayor ng 2020 at 2021.

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Asan po yung para sa salary differential niya ng January? To June 2022 bago siya naging vice president. Hindi po ba dapat meron din siya rin?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Wala na po kasi tama na po ang na-prepare ng city mayors for that salary January 2021.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Ah, na-correct na yung salary niya para sa January. Hindi lang na-correct para sa 2020 and 2021.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Attorney Lindon, your witness.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: I'll just jump off from the question of the presiding officer. So, itong amount po na to, sinabi niyo na galing sa...

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: So hindi po ito galing sa any service or practice of profession na ginawa niya habang siya ay vice president?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Hindi po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: The witness already answered, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: We then move to strike, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: For brevity, Attorney Mae, I'll allow it. But, Attorney Lindon, kindly be more conscious in regard to that. Although we are sui generis, still try to...

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: And want to abbreviate the proceedings in regard to this witness because clearly we already get what you're trying to prove with this witness. But we'll allow it in the meantime. Please proceed, Attorney Lindon.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: That would be our last question, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Atty. May, cross.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. May we be given maybe 10 minutes, Your Honor, just to organize our cross, Your Honor, because this is the first time that, first, we're seeing these documents, and second, that we are hearing this theory of the defense, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: We're giving you until 1.40, Atty. May, which is roughly 5 minutes.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Thank you.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Trial is in recess.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Any cross, Atty. May?

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. Quite lengthy, in fact, Your Honor. Good afternoon, Mr. Bahan.

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Good afternoon po, attorney.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Kanina nung tinatanong ka ng inyong posisyon, sinabi mo na ikaw ang city accountant ng Davao City.

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Yes po, attorney.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: At

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: ikaw ay nagsimula bilang city accountant ng Davao City noong 2016.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: At kinukumpirma mo rin na ang unang nagtalaga sa iyo bilang city accountant ay ang respondent sa kasong ito na si Vice President Sara Duterte.

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Vice President

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: as Mayor. As

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Mayor. So siya rin ang nagtalaga sa iyo bilang City Accountant?

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Yes po, sa term po niya. Pero matagal na po ako sa City Accountant's Office. Yes,

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: but as City Accountant, ang Vice President ang nagtalaga sa inyo nung time na, nung panahon na siya pa ay Mayor ng City of Davao.

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Kasi po nag-retire na po yung City Accountant namin that time.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Yes, thank you for those information, Ms. Bahan. Just to remind you, moving forward, please just be responsive to the questions. Don't volunteer information that is not being asked of you.

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Yes po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Salamat po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Papatutuhanan mo rin po na noong 2018, maliban sa pagiging city accountant, itinilaga rin kayo ng respondent bilang chairperson ng city audit and transition teams for barangay. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Ano po, attorney?

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Tinalaga rin kayo nung 2018 bilang chairperson ng City Audit and Transition Teams for Barangay ng parehong tao na si Vice President Sara Duterte.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Your Honor, may

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: we know the relevance of this question?

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Your Honor, if

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: she knows, if she knows counsel, we'll allow it. She's testing the credibility of the witness.

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Yung parang sa barangay election po, ako yung vice chair.

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Yung parang committee yan, yan po yung committee na yan, attorney. Maliban

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: pa po doon sa pagtatalaga sa inyo na kabilang sa Investigating Committee ng Lungsod ng 2020, ikaw rin po ay itinalaga na chairperson ng City Audit and Transition Teams for Barangay.

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Yes

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: po, kasi may DILG circular po pero co-chair po ako, yung taga-BICAD po. Chairperson.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Aside

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: from this, you were also designated as member of the investigating committee of the City of Davao in 2020. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Yes po. At

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: ito po ay on top of your position as city accountant. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Yes po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: At nagpatuloy rin po kayo sa paglilingkod. Sa pamahala ang lungsod, matapos bumaba si Vice President Sara Duterte bilang mayor. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Yes po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Sa katunayan, hanggang ngayon, city accountant pa rin po kayo sa ilalim ng kanyang kapatid na si Mayor Sebastian Duterte. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Yes po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: At itinalaga kayong muli ni Mayor Sebastian Duterte sa Investigating Committee ng Lungsod ng... Noong 2024. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Yes po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Okay. Kanina din po, during your direct examination, tinanong kayo kung ano pang mga posisyon ang inyong hinawakan sa lungsod ng Davao at sinabi ninyo na humawak kayo ng job order position mula 2001 hanggang 2004. Tama po ba yung pagkakalala ko?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Yes po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Pero kinukumpirman nyo rin po na in 2003, nag-register Ang inyong accounting firm ng Articles of Partnership sa Securities and Exchange Commission. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: May we know the relevance, Your Honor?

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Again, Your Honor, this will go into the bias and interest of this witness, Your Honor. Under Section 6, Article or Rule 132 of the Rules of Court on Cross-Examination, the witness may be examined with sufficient fullness and freedom to test the accuracy and truthfulness. of the witness, as well as...

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Nakumbinsin mo na, Atty. Mae. Winidraw na nga ni Atty. Lindon yung objection niya.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor. So, just to refresh your memory, papakita ko po sa inyo ang articles of partnership ng isang Ampil, Elises, Ciudadano, and Co. CPAs.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Just to correct myself, Your Honor. The firm was not incorporated. It was registered with the SEC.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: May we be given time to produce a document before the prosecution may ask questions?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: You have your assisting counsel there, counsel. You can get a copy as well so that you can look at it too for your redirect.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Again, continuing authority is given not only to assisting counsel, but to counsels rather, but also to handling counsels.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Naaalala niyo na po ba, Ms. Bahan? At kinukumpirman niyo rin po ba na noong 2003, nag-register ang inyong accounting firm sa SEC. At ang accounting firm na ito ay ang Ampil, Elises, Ciudadano & Co. CPAs. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Yun pong after graduation ko po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Paki

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: -sagot lang po yung tanong ko. Ang tanong ko po, Kinukumpirman niyo po ba na noong 2003, yung accounting firm niyo po nag-register sa Securities and Exchange Commission ng accounting firm? At ikaw po? Sige.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: The

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: witness was answering the question, Your Honor.
