turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Ms. Ivan, Wala naman pong sinasabi si Atty. May na may ginawa kayong illegal per se? Wala po naman kayong niyalabag na batas kung naging bahagi kayo niyan?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Yes po, nag-rewind lang po ako, nag-memory ko po kasi matagal na po ito, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Um, hingi ako ng paumanhin, Ms. Ivana, kung naging bahagi ka ng isang accounting firm, accountant po kayo, mahirap naman po siguro makaligtaan niyon sa profesional niyong karera. So, forgive me, Senator Judge Rafi.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Thank you,

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Mr. Presiding Officer. Alam mo, natatakot ako para sa'yo kasi napakasimple lamang katanungan and very invasive at hindi mo masagot-sagot. Yung katanungan lang kung signature mo yun o hindi, hindi mo masagot-sagot. Paano pa kaya mamaya? I'm sure maraming mga hard questions. Kung tawagin kudigra, you know what is kudigra? It means yung mga katanungan na talagang the final blow, ika nga. Paano pag kung ngayong pangalan sa signature pa lamang, hindi mo kayang sagutin yun, baka yung mga mahirap na katanungan later on. Baka makontempt ka. Sana wag. Kami, napipiko na. You've been very evasive to a very simple question. Patingin-tingin ka pa sa mga pages na nandiyan man sa harap mo yung signature mo. All you need to do is tell... The lawyer asking the question, yes, that's my signature or no, that's not my signature. E tumitingin-tingin ka ng mga different pages na walang kinalaman sa signature mo. Ma'am, ako alam ko ang signature ko sa biglang tingin ko. Ngayon kung hindi ka sigurado, all you can tell us is hindi akong pumirman yan, pinayaki ang pirma ko or that's my signature or I cannot remember. Ganun lang na I signed that. Tatlo lang. E ang pinatatagal mo, humahabang oras natin. Please don't be very evasive. Sa ngayon, very simple question lang yan ha. Mamaya, I'm sure marami pa mga mahirap na katanungan. Baka abutin tayo hanggang madaling araw, mapipikong kami, baka makontem ka.

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Sorry po, you're on.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Presiding Officer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Noted, Senator Judge Raffi. Please proceed, Attorney May.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Ulitin ko, Ms. Bahan. Base sa dokumentong hawak, pinapatutuhanan mo ba or kinukumpirma mo na noong September 2015, nag-amend ng Articles of Partnership ang dating Ampil, Elises, Ciudadano, and Co. CPAs? Tama po. Kinukumpirma niyo?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Hindi ko po ma-remember, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Nandiyan po yung dokumento. Ito po ang tatunan.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: That's the answer of the witness, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Ano po hindi niyo mahalala, Ms. Ivan? Yung petsa o na-inamiyandahan?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Yung pag-amen po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Yung pag-amen? Hindi niyo po naalala umalis kayo sa accounting firm na dati niyong parting pagmamayari?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: I'm sorry, Ms. Ivan. Kung yung petsa po hindi niyo naalala, maunawaan po namin yun.

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Yes po, ang date po. Talaga yung specific date po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Pero...

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Sinasangayunan niyo ba na inamiyendahan yung General Articles of Partnership kung saan maliban sa ibang bagay ay umalis na kayo bilang partner, bahagi, parte ng accounting firm na yan?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Yes or no, ma'am?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Yes po,

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: your honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Your witness attorney, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Maaaring mo pa ang tingnan ng parehong dokumento, Ms. Bahan. At sa top right-hand portion ng parehong dokumento, lumalabas ang SEC registration.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: May we know what document and page the prosecution

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: is referring to?

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: The first page of both documents of the original Articles of Partnership and the amended Articles of Partnership.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: You will confirm. That both documents bear the same SEC registration number.

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Page 2003, 2023. Ang

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: nakalagay po dito is pareho. Pareho.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Okay. Now, Ms. Bahan, sa pagkakaalam mo, ay kukumpirmahin nyo rin ba, kung inyong alam, na itong Elises and Ciudadano ay ang parehong Elises and Ciudadano? na tinalaga bilang external auditor ng Gen Corp, Metro City Chow, Town Times Square B, City Hall King Chow, Chinese Gen B, Carpio Lawyer, Davao New Royal Taipan, Great Jolly Times Food Corporation na makikita sa mga general information sheets ng mga dokumentong ito. Again, just to

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Help you out. We will be confronting you with the necessary general information sheets of these corporations.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: We would have to object, Your Honor. No basis and incompetent,

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Your Honor. If

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: she knows, counsel, because she was part of the firm.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Nung panahon nandun kayo sa firm, sa accounting firm, nagsilbi po ba yung accounting firm ninyo bilang external accountant? Nung mga kumpanyang binanggit ni Atty. May.

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Hindi ko po ma-remember your honor sa tagal na po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Again, just to aid you.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Mr. President, I have here, you know, Madam Witness, I wanted to help you and I really wanted to make sure that you magsasabi po kayo ng pawang katotohanan para...

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Mayroon kayong kapayapaan. Kasi from my point of view, hirap na hirap po kayo eh. You should not be. Hindi po dapat mangyari yun. Kasi sasabihin nyo lang po kung ano yung nalalaman nyo, ano yung katotohanan. Dito po sa amended articles of partnership, meron po kayo affidavit of withdrawal, August of 2020.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: August of 2015. So paano po hindi nyo makakalimutan ito? Kung dito po meron po kayo na affidavit of withdrawal, binabanggit po ninyo na kayo ay partner, nakalagay po dito yung number 2, sabi nyo, I resigned in the partnership effective August 1, 2015 due to personal reasons. Number 3, I am executing this affidavit proposed to inform the SEC that I am formally withdrawing as partner nito pong Ampil, Elises, Ciudadano and Company, CPAs. Meron po kayong ganito, Madam Witness. Kaya para sa amin na nakikinig, Nakita namin dito, ay naku po, sigurado po ako ito yung pirman ninyo kasi ito yung nasa official record eh. Tapos sasabihin nyo po, hindi nyo maalala, hindi nyo po alam, eh mahirap po kaming makumbinsin ng ganun. At alam nyo, we're practicing utmost patience to you. I hope you help us help you. So baka pwede hong sagutin nyo yung tanong ng maayos.

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Sorry po your honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: But

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: you do not contest o hindi po ito kathang isip lamang itong binabanggit ko po na kayo po ay nagkaroon ng affidavit of withdrawal.

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Yes po your honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: August 2015. Salamat po Mr. Presiding Officer. Attorney May, your witness.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Ms. Bahan, before niyo sagutin po yung katanungan ko, para lang mas kumampante kayo, maaari po kayong uminom ng tubig muna.

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Salamat po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Please

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: proceed, Attorney May.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Now, nasa inyo na, Ms. Bahan, yung mga general information sheets nung mga kumpanya ang inenumerate ko kanina. Your Honor, for the record, we are confronting the witness with the following documents. Prosecutions P, Roman numeral number 2-2-4-3-A, page 3, P.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: maaari niyo pong tingnan yung pages 3 and 2 ng mga nasabing dokumento. Diyan po sa mga pages na yan, makikita po. Ang itinalagang external auditor ng mga kumpanyang nabanggit ko. At makikita rin dyan ang pangalang Elises Ciudadano.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Attorney Mae, this is for what year?

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Various years, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: I'm sorry, what years?

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Various, different years, Your Honor, for each corporation.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: No, but does it cover what years in particular? Because...

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: By your own questioning and documents you presented, she left the accounting firm in 2015.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Yes, 2019, Your Honor. But I'm just asking if she is aware, Your Honor, if this firm is the same Elises Ciudadano appearing in these documents. If she knows.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: In that case, if she knows. If it's after 2015.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Your Honor, I think that the line of questioning would be irrelevant and the witness would be incompetent to answer that question, Your Honor, considering that the very document being showed by the prosecution would show that the witness is no longer connected with that entity, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Your Honor, first, counsel is already testifying for the witness.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: I'm

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: explaining.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Counsel, please. If you know, Ms. Ivan.

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Hindi ko po alam, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: I think you've established, Attorney May, that it's one and the same firm. But since it's after 2015, she would not be in a position to. Unless she has personal knowledge outside of being a part of that accounting firm. Please proceed, Attorney May.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Punta na po tayo sa susunod na paksa. Ms. Bahan, you will also confirm that you are one of the Davao City officials who traveled to China in December 2025.

turns.text: Correct?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: First week po ng December po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Mas masarap po bang galunggong sa China, Ms. Bahan? Mas

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: mura po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Mas mura. Okay.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: At you will also confirm, Ms. Bahan, na nagbiyahi rin sa China, kung inyong alam, nagbiyahi rin sa China ang iba pang opisyal ng Davao City noong Enero 2026. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Hindi ko po alam

turns.text: kasi yung akin lang po ang alam po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Okay.

turns.text: Hindi po kayo kasama? Hindi

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: po yung first week ng December po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Yes. Okay.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Punta na po tayo dun sa sinasabi ninyong salary

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: differential kanina. Ang

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: sinasabi ninyo pong salary differential ay pareho po. Tama po ba? Naisipin ko na yung sinasabi ninyong salary differential ay pareho dun sa amount na makikita. Sa Form 2316 na inyong pinirmahan noong 2023?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Yes po, attorney.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: At ang Form 2316 ay inihanda at ibinibigay ng employer. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Yes po, attorney.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Ngayon, itong Form 2316 na ito, which is Prosecutions Exhibit P-2-3-2-4-16-DIR,

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Ito ay pinirmahan ninyo bilang city accountant, tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Yes po, attorney.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: At ang form na ito ay naguulat ng kompensasyong ibinayad at buwis na kinalta para sa taong 2023, tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Yung paid po namin for year 2023 po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Okay. Ngayon itong, pero you will confirm that this form 2316 that you signed,

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: pinapakita nito.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Ang kompensasyong ibinayad at buwis na kinaltas ng City of Davao sa sweldo na kinaltas para sa 2023. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Yung paid po sa 2023. Hindi po ibig sabihin na compensation for 2023.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Yes. Tama, tama. Sorry. I'm

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: sorry.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Pero inuulat nito na yung... Binayad at ang buwis na kinaltas. Tama ba?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Yes po, attorney.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: At ayon sa inyo, itong amount na pinapakita dito ay it corresponds to the salary differential.

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Yes po, for the year 2020 and 2021 as a city mayor po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Ngayon kanina, may tinukoy kayong batas, yung salary standardization law. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Yes po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: At ito ay ipinasah? As early as January 2020. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Nasa nosa. Check ko po, attorney ha. Itong nasa nosa po. Sige po.

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Itong nasa nosa po. Bali ang effectivity po ng salary standardization of 2019 sa 2020 na po ang effectivity.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Correct.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: 2020. First tranche is 2020. Second tranche is 2021. At yung sinabi mo na Adjustment na inyong ginawa which corresponds to the amount appearing in the form 2316 that we just identified. It corresponds to the period supposedly 2020 and 2021.

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Yes, attorney.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Pero ina-admit nyo kanina na naipasa na yung batas as early as January 2020. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Hindi lang ako familiar

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: po ng batas po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Pero sinasabi niyo na effectivity nito, yung

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: first chance is as early as 2020.

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Tapos 2020 po ang effectivity.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: So ibig sabihin, bago pa na-incur yung salary in 2020 and 2021, alam niyo na yung adjustment.

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Yes

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: po, kasi ang basis po namin itong NOSA po, yung Notice of Salary Adjustment po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: At

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: ang gusto nyong sabihin at iparating sa korte na ito na kahit bago pa ma-incur supposedly yung salary in 2020 and 2021, ginawa nyo lamang yung adjustment a year after, a year later, or two years later. For the first tranche, two years later, and for the second tranche, one year later. or in January 2023. Tama

turns.text: po ba?

turns.text: Ang city accountants po ay nag-review lang po pero ang nag-prepare po ang per office po.

turns.text: Okay. Pero pinapatutuhanan ninyo na kahit na isa batas, alam na sa batas na ang effectivity ng itong batas na ito ay as early as 2020 and 2021 bago pa supposedly na-incur yung salary. Ginawa lamang yung adjustment ng City of Davao for the first tranche two years later and for the second tranche one year later or in December 2022. Base sa document.

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Hindi po ako ano ng buong storya pero kung titignan natin ang records po parang na-overlook po ang adjustments.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Na-overlook. Okay.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Ngayon balik po tayo sa Form 2023 na inyong pinirmahan. Bago niyo po ito pinirmahan, I'm sure chineck niyo po ito. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Yes po, attorney.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: At by the time, kinukumpirman niyo rin na by the time bayaran itong supposed adjustment na ito, hindi na mayor ng Davao City si vice president kasi siya na ay na talaga or na-elect bilang vice president. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Yes po, attorney.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Tama rin po ba? Sabihin na since you've been the city accountant since 2016, eto pong Form 2316 na ito. Hindi ito ang unang 2316 na inyong pinirmahan. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Yes po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Marami na kayong Forms 2316 na napirmahan.

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Yes po, Atty.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Ngayon, kung pitingnan niyo po, meron po ba kayong kopya ng Form 2316 na aking tinutukoy?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Yung sa reference ko po, Atty.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Can we please confront?

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: We are confronting you with Prosecutions Exhibit P-2-3-2-4-16-BIR.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Tinukumpirma po na base sa dokumentong iyan, hindi nyo sinulat or tinukoy sa form na iyan kung para sa ang panahon ng servisyo ang halagang tinutukoy dyan sa form na iyan. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Yes po, attorney.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Hindi rin tinutukoy kung aling payroll o disbursement voucher ang pinagmula ng halagang yan. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Yes po, attorney.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Sa sarili nito, hindi rin ipinapakita ng form kung ang amount na kinita, kung ang amount na nakalista dyan ay kinita bago pa noong 2023. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Yes po, attorney.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Hindi rin ipinapakita sa form na yan. Ang batayan ng amount na nakasaad dyan, tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Yes po, attorney.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Pinapatutuhanan nyo rin na ang form na yan, ang nakasaad ay, ang year na nakasaad ay 2023, tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Yes po, attorney.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Kung kaya, you will agree with me na based on the document alone, kung titignan lamang ang form na yan, walang nagpapakita na ang amount na nakasaad dyan. Ay para sa naantalang sahod, or sorry, para sa salary differential, tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Yes po, attorney.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Ngayon, yung bayad po sa sinasabing yung salary differential, nilabas lamang noong 2023, tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Yes po, attorney.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: At

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: noong 2023, ang kapatid na ng vice mayor, ah sorry, ang kapatid na ng vice president na si Mayor Sebastian Duterte, Ang tumatay yung mayor ng Davao City, tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Vingeline A. Bahan
turns.text: Yes po, attorney.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: At ang mga disbursement voucher ng lungsod ay inaaprubahan ng mayor o ng kanyang authorized representative, tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Senator-judges have indicated their desire to call it a day. I see Senator Kiko nodding, Senator Bam earlier as well, Senator Joel and Senator... Ping, and Senator Judge Sotto as well.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So I guess we call it a day for the day. Tomorrow, the first witness that will be presented will be the Barangay Captain first. Would that be correct,

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Attorney Sheila?

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. Your Honor, may I just, since the court had decided to call it a day, in good faith, we will now disclose that we will no longer present The Punong Barangay, the fifth witness in our list, Cindy Colina, The Punong Barangay.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Well, at

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: least

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: I can count

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: him as a third witness for today if you're

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: dispensing with him.

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. So that the prosecution is also informed ahead. This is of course without prejudice to any subsequent motion that we will make on the courts taking judicial...

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: notice of the geographical divisions with respect to the subject barangays, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Yes, without prejudice to that. So you will be presenting Attorney Punay tomorrow.

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: At attorney Suzette Balucanag Punay, Your Honor. And therefore, Your Honor, we will also ask for this court to already recall the subpoena if one has already been issued to Ms. Colina. and excuse her from further attendance in this proceeding. Thank you.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Chair hereby directs that the withdrawal and recall of the subpoena issued to the Hon. Barpunong Barangay of Matina Crossing, Davao City, the Hon. Colina. So ordered. So tomorrow we shall have Atty. Punay, thereafter the bank representatives. Do you have a particular sequence, Atty. Sheila, for the bank reps? Or will they be as they appear in your request for subpoena?

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. For now, that would be the order, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Okay. In the case of Atty. Punay, to abbreviate the proceedings, will she be bringing with her documents that have not yet been marked? Would you be aware of that, Atty. Sheila, or whoever will be handling it?

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: She will also be identifying records that have already been marked. In fact, part of the records of the court. But if in case that she will identify additional documents, we will make sure to prepare additional copies so that the prosecution will be given copies tomorrow.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Yes, please.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: and the

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: And for the court, Your Honor. Thank you.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you very much. There being any other matter? Yes.

turns.text: Okay.

turns.text: Walang tawad yun manong ping... Apo. Apo. There being no other matter to be taken up, Honorable Ridon, nothing? Attorney May, nothing.
